significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish a form-(iii) law: conditional backdoors cause a measurable "paraphrase-invariance violation," with semantically equivalent trigger-crossing inputs producing a sharp activation discontinuity and heavier-tailed local dispersion. This would constrain expectations across unseen triggers and support a concrete explanation for detecting dormant behavior, addressing the persistence problem illustrated by Hubinger et al.'s 2024 Sleeper Agents results rather than merely identifying a representation correlated with one failure. It establishes a behavioral phenomenon and an abstract gate mechanism, though not a decomposition into particular components; a negative result would importantly rule out this discontinuity as a necessary, universal signature, albeit without ruling out other trigger-agnostic signatures. True and false are distinguishable despite underspecified quantitative thresholds, and the topic-substitution check passes: generic mechanistic LLM safety would not imply this specific paraphrase-to-activation relation, so the score is not inherited from the topic.

reach.justification: The named handles are a "model-level screen" based on the local Lipschitz/anomaly profile and an "inference-time input flag" based on outlier status relative to a paraphrase cloud. Both are ex ante: the first can screen a suspicious model before deployment, while the second can flag a prompt before attacker-specified output is emitted, giving auditors or deployment operators an action window. After per-model recalibration, the claimed relation still predicts heavier-tailed dispersion and a trigger-crossing discontinuity rather than merely prescribing an open-ended search procedure, although the stated limitation to "mid-size open-weight models and fine-tuning-injected backdoors" restricts confidence in transfer to pretraining or model-editing attacks. The topic-substitution check passes because generic safety interpretability supplies neither these screening handles nor their lead time; their plausible uptake by model auditors and deployment practitioners supports reach above the topic median.
